# InternetOstrava.cz

> InternetOstrava.cz helps residents of Ostrava and the surrounding region verify the availability of internet service for an exact address. The homepage and conversion pages are provider-neutral; the dedicated PODA pages explain availability checks for the PODA network and are operated by a sales representative of PODA a.s., not by PODA a.s. itself.

## Main pages

- [Internet Ostrava](https://internetostrava.cz/): provider-neutral overview, indicative tariffs, address verification, and frequently asked questions
- [PODA internet Ostrava](https://internetostrava.cz/poda-internet-ostrava/): focused explanation of how PODA internet availability is verified by exact address in Ostrava
- [PODA dostupnost](https://internetostrava.cz/poda-dostupnost/): explanation of how PODA coverage and availability are verified per exact address
- [PODA internet Karviná](https://internetostrava.cz/poda-karvina/): availability verification for addresses in Karviná and surroundings
- [Availability verification](https://internetostrava.cz/dostupnost/): how internet availability is determined per exact address in Ostrava, what affects the result at building level, what to prepare, plus a non-binding check form
- [Tariffs](https://internetostrava.cz/tarify/): indicative options subject to address verification
- [Contact](https://internetostrava.cz/kontakt/): representative contact details
- [Lokality overview](https://internetostrava.cz/lokality/): provider-neutral directory of Ostrava districts grouped by area, each linking to a local availability page

## Local pages by district

Each local page verifies internet availability by exact address; content is unique per district and describes the local building stock (panel estates, tenement houses, family homes, mining colonies). No coverage percentages are used.

- [Ostrava-Poruba](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-ostrava-poruba/): sorela blocks, panel houses, and family homes at the edges
- [Ostrava-Jih](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-ostrava-jih/): overview hub for the Jih district (Hrabuvka, Zabreh, Dubina, Vyskovice, Belsky Les)
- [Hrabuvka](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-hrabuvka/): panel houses around the shopping centre and the brick Sidlovec colony
- [Zabreh](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-zabreh/): panel estates and older brick tenement houses
- [Dubina](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-ostrava-dubina/): the youngest panel estate of the Jih district
- [Vyskovice](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-vyskovice/): panel houses and original family-home development near Belsky les
- [Belsky Les](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-belsky-les/): panel estate set within greenery
- [Marianské Hory](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-marianske-hory/): flats and family homes in wider central Ostrava
- [Hulvaky](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-hulvaky/): smaller locality with colonies and apartment houses near Bazaly
- [Moravska Ostrava](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-moravska-ostrava/): central Ostrava addresses
- [Privoz](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-ostrava-privoz/): historic quarter of Art Nouveau tenement houses by the main station
- [Vitkovice](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-ostrava-vitkovice/): brick industrial development in central Ostrava
- [Svinov](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-svinov/): transport hub with family homes and low apartment buildings near the station
- [Pustkovec](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-pustkovec/): quiet family-home area next to Poruba and the VSB campus
- [Trebovice](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-trebovice/): residential area with family homes and a chateau park
- [Slezska Ostrava](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-slezska-ostrava/): family and apartment houses close to the centre
- [Muglinov](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-muglinov/): family development and a panel estate on the right bank of the Ostravice
- [Michalkovice](https://internetostrava.cz/internet-michalkovice/): mining colonies and family homes near the Michal colliery

## Advice hub (Poradna)

- [Poradna](https://internetostrava.cz/poradna/): practical guides for choosing internet service in Ostrava
- [Fiber availability check guide](https://internetostrava.cz/poradna/dostupnost-optickeho-internetu-ostrava/): how fiber availability is verified per exact address and why neighbouring buildings differ
- [Fiber vs. wireless comparison](https://internetostrava.cz/poradna/optika-vs-bezdratovy-internet/): stability, latency, symmetric upload, and weather resilience compared
- [Internet for home office](https://internetostrava.cz/poradna/internet-pro-home-office-ostrava/): why stability and upload matter more than headline download speed
- [Household speed guide](https://internetostrava.cz/poradna/jaka-rychlost-internetu-pro-domacnost/): indicative speed guidance by household size and usage
- [Switching provider FAQ](https://internetostrava.cz/poradna/caste-otazky-pred-zmenou-poskytovatele/): correct order of steps to switch without downtime

## Canonical query aliases

Short query-style paths such as `/poda-ostrava`, `/poda-poruba`, `/internet-poruba`, `/internet-privoz`, and `/internet-dubina` redirect to the closest canonical landing page instead of creating duplicate thin pages. District names that have their own local page (for example Hrabuvka, Zabreh, Vyskovice) are served directly at `/internet-<district>/`.
